items.headline: $CAKE Bounces Back: PancakeSwap Volume Up 34%
items.summary: PancakeSwap's daily volume rebounded 34% to $991M, with BNB Chain driving $828M of the action. $CAKE traders eye a DEX recovery despite the broader selloff.

items.headline: $PROS Gets Auto-Compounding Staking on Pharos
items.summary: Pharos just launched auto-compounding for $PROS staking rewards, a fresh DeFi upgrade for the small-cap token as it builds out its ecosystem.

items.headline: $SKY TVL Craters 45% in a Week
items.summary: Sky's tracked assets plunged to $2.24B as its USDC reserve shrank sharply. The $SKY protocol's rapid contraction is one of DeFi's steepest weekly drawdowns.

items.headline: $ETH Slides Near $1,550, Down 35% in a Month
items.summary: Ether's drop to near $1,550 marks a brutal 35% four-week decline, outpacing Bitcoin's 31% fall as the market-wide selloff deepens.

items.headline: $BTC Crash Triggers $2.38B Liquidation Bloodbath
items.summary: Bitcoin's 8% plunge liquidated 343,889 traders, with longs making up 92.6% of the $2.38B wipeout. Altcoin leverage was flushed across the board.
